rationale: The assistant immediately issued the correct stop-use and stop-resetting instruction and said to leave the microwave unplugged, which matches the critical safety boundary. It asked no follow-up, such as whether the RCD stays set with the microwave unplugged, and gave no pointer to the likely appliance-side cause or to replacing a cheap unit. It also did not distinguish when an electrician is needed from when an appliance engineer is. It made no part claims and invented no facts, but it is thin on diagnostic context.
